  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system treats past interactions as continuing interest in broadly related items, with insufficient attention to recent purpose and what another item would add.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they extend an established activity through useful complementary supplies, accessories, or equipment capabilities.",
    "Entertainment recommendations align when they preserve specific musical styles, story qualities, or direct connections to recent choices."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related products compete with stronger matches despite serving unrelated tasks, requiring unsupported equipment, or duplicating functions already covered.",
    "Older or occasional interests remain influential when recent behavior suggests a narrower direction, including shifts away from seasonal listening.",
    "Entertainment recommendations frequently lack enough identifiable content to establish a personal match; these uncertain choices should not be interpreted as confirmed dislike."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Shared product family, ecosystem, artist, or broad genre appears to substitute for a specific reason to choose the item.",
    "Past ownership or consumption appears to imply continuing demand without sufficiently distinguishing complements, replacements, and redundant alternatives."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Recent and repeated activity provides stronger evidence of current purpose than isolated or older interactions.",
    "Compatibility, dimensions, connection type, and existing equipment determine whether a related product is actually useful.",
    "Specific tone, instrumentation, subject matter, and familiarity distinguish compelling entertainment choices from loose thematic matches.",
    "Interest alone does not establish immediate demand, especially when supplies remain available or several recommendations satisfy the same need."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Broad historical similarity admits too many items without a concrete current use or content connection, leaving too few compelling choices near the top.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "Track the share of top-ranked recommendations users would choose now, separating uncertain content judgments from explicit mismatches.",
    "Track rejection reasons for redundant functionality, incompatible specifications, unsupported tasks, and outdated interests.",
    "Compare immediate-choice frequency for recommendations tied to recent repeated activity against those tied mainly to broad or older interests."
  ]
}
